业余无线电竞赛提交日志的标准纯文本格式。: The standard plain-text format for submitting amateur radio contest logs.
以 START-OF-LOG / END-OF-LOG 包裹，含台站与比赛信息。: Wrapped in START-OF-LOG / END-OF-LOG, containing the station and contest information.
保留原始日志，便于申诉或核对通联有效性。: Keep the original log, for appeals or to verify that contacts are valid.
在比赛官网指定截止时间前提交日志。: Submit the log before the deadline stated on the contest website.
按规则统计通联数、系数（分区 / 前缀 / 州）与总分。: The rules tally contacts, multipliers (zone / prefix / state) and the total score.
提交前核对呼号、交换信息与时间，格式错误会被拒收。: Check callsigns, exchanges and times before submitting — format errors are rejected.
每条记录：频率、模式、日期、时间、对方呼号、交换信息。: Each record: frequency, mode, date, time, the other station's callsign and the exchange.
用日志软件（N1MM、DXLog 等）自动导出 Cabrillo，避免手工出错。: Export Cabrillo automatically with logging software (N1MM, DXLog, etc.) to avoid manual errors.
